payload.content: You can renew a U.S. passport online through the State Department's Online Passport Renewal system on travel.state.gov. You are generally eligible if you are 25 or older, your most recent passport was issued when you were 16 or older and within the last 15 years, you are not changing your name (or have documentation), and you are not traveling internationally for at least six weeks. You sign in with a MyTravelGov account, upload a digital photo, and pay the $130 fee by card. If you are not eligible, use Form DS-82 to renew by mail.
